title: Implement Tunnel Authorization (spec 8.11)
description: Implement egress tunnel authorization per 06-security.md 8.11. Root sends CoAP POST to /.well-known/tunnel-auth with Schnorr48-signed authorization. Egress validates and caches. Data plane checks auth table before decapsulation.
notes: UPDATED: Now uses COSE_Sign1 (RFC 9052) with Schnorr48-Ed25519 algorithm (-65537). Implementations need COSE library or manual Sig_structure construction.
close_reason: All Python, Rust, Zephyr, vector, and cross-validation children are closed with exact decision/byte parity across the finalized fixture.
